scope: Source-reported Temporal family acceptance; no benchmark-authored counterfactual variants are included.

selection.unit: one source paper contributing at most one accepted family
selection.core20_rule: Sort all accepted families by frozen production cohort number, then by frozen paper order; select the first 20.

validation_contract.mandatory_actual_control_gate: Every control is a numeric quantity actually set or manipulated in the reported experiment, computation, or protocol.
validation_contract.known_truth_interpretation: A development canary showing that the deterministic target submission survives held-out evaluation; it is not a measured LLM benchmark score.

release_limits.permitted_claim: Twenty-one source-reported Temporal family release candidates passed this model-based, source-grounded validation record; twenty are designated core20 by fixed acquisition order and one is an extension.
